about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A31: lunches (noodle and rice bowls, hot sandwiches, quesadillas, tacos, fritters, pancakes and rolls) from Japan, China, Vietnam, India, Italy, Mexico and the US.

recipes.title: Omurice (Japanese Chicken Fried Rice in a Soft Omelette)
recipes.summary: Ketchup-flavoured chicken fried rice wrapped in a soft, silky omelette, a Japanese comfort lunch.
steps: Cook the rice per the packet until tender, about 12 minutes.

Fry the chicken and onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through to 75°C. Add the peas, rice and tomato sauce and stir-fry for 3 minutes, until the rice is evenly coloured and hot.
Beat the eggs with salt. Cook half in half the butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat for 2 minutes, until just set with a soft top.
Spoon half the rice onto the omelette, fold over and slide onto a plate. Repeat for the second serve.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and the egg must be set, not raw. Eat straight away; refrigerate leftover rice within an hour.
Contains egg and milk.

recipes.title: Chicken Yaki Udon (with Cabbage and Mushroom)
recipes.summary: Thick, chewy udon stir-fried with chicken, cabbage and mushrooms in a savoury soy and mirin glaze.
steps: Cook the udon per the packet until tender and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in half the oil for 5 minutes, until cooked through to 75°C. Remove.
Stir-fry the cabbage, mushroom and carrot in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, until just tender.
Add the noodles, chicken, soy sauce and mirin and toss for 2 minutes, until glossy and hot. Finish with the sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour; for a packed lunch use an ice pack, eat within 4 hours and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains gluten, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Cold Sesame Chicken Noodles (with Cucumber)
recipes.summary: Chilled wheat noodles with poached chicken, cucumber and a creamy tahini and soy dressing, a no-reheat packed lunch.
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 minutes, until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains. Cool, then shred.
Cook the noodles per the packet until tender, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the tahini, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar and warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the dressing, cucumber and chicken and top with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C, then be chilled within an hour and kept below 5°C. For a packed lunch use an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
Contains gluten, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Peanut Noodle Bowl (with Crispy Tofu)
recipes.summary: Rice noodles in a lime and chilli peanut sauce with golden tofu, carrot and cucumber, good warm or cold.
steps: Soak or cook the noodles per the packet until tender, then drain and rinse.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp on all sides.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, sriracha and 1/4 cup warm water until smooth and pourable.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, carrot and cucumber, top with the tofu and coriander.
notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge; add the tofu on the day. Check the soy sauce label if avoiding gluten.
Contains peanuts and soy.

recipes.title: Zha Jiang Mian (Beijing Pork and Bean Sauce Noodles)
recipes.summary: Chewy noodles under a thick, savoury pork and bean sauce with cool cucumber, a Beijing home lunch.
steps: Brown the pork in the oil for 8 minutes, until no pink remains, with the garlic and ginger.
Stir in the doubanjiang, hoisin, soy sauce, sugar and water and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick and glossy and the pork reaches 75°C.
Cook the noodles per the packet until tender and drain.
Serve the noodles topped with the sauce, cucumber and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C with no pink. The sauce keeps 3 days in the fridge; reheat until steaming hot. For a packed lunch use an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
Contains gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein (with Cabbage and Carrot)
recipes.summary: Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, cabbage, carrot and capsicum in a savoury soy and oyster sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles per the packet until just tender, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the chicken in half the oil over high heat for 5 minutes, until cooked through to 75°C. Remove.
Stir-fry the cabbage, carrot and capsicum in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil and toss for 2 minutes, until hot.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour; for a packed lunch use an ice pack, eat within 4 hours and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains egg, gluten, soy and shellfish (oyster sauce).

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu Don (Crumbed Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl)
recipes.summary: Crisp panko chicken simmered briefly in sweet soy broth and egg, served over steaming rice.
steps: Cook the rice per the packet until tender, about 12 minutes.
Coat the chicken in flour, the single beaten egg, then panko. Shallow fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through to 75°C. Slice.
Simmer the onion with the stock, soy sauce, mirin and sugar for 4 minutes, until soft.
Lay the chicken in the pan, pour over the two beaten eggs, cover and cook for 2 minutes, until just set. Slide over the rice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and the egg must be set. Best eaten straight away; refrigerate leftovers within an hour.
Contains egg, gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Italian Sub (with Salami, Ham and Mozzarella)
recipes.summary: Salami, ham and mozzarella with crisp lettuce and an oregano and vinegar dressing in a crusty roll.
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano and brush over the cut sides of the bread.
Layer the ham, salami and cheese on the base, then the tomato, onion and lettuce, piling until generously full.
Close, press firmly and cut in half.
notes: Food safety: cured meats and cheese should stay below 5°C. For a packed lunch use an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmigiana Rolls (with Marinara)
recipes.summary: Crumbed chicken breast under tomato sauce and melted mozzarella in a toasted roll.
steps: Coat the cutlets in flour, egg, then panko.
Shallow fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through to 75°C.
Top with the marinara and cheese and grill for 3 minutes, until the cheese bubbles.
Toast the rolls until crisp and fill with the cutlets.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains egg, milk and gluten.

recipes.title: Chilli Dogs (with Beef and Bean Sauce)
recipes.summary: Frankfurts in soft buns under a quick smoky beef and bean chilli, an American lunch counter favourite.
steps: Brown the beef and onion for 8 minutes until no pink remains, then add the spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick and the beef reaches 75°C.
Heat the frankfurts in simmering water for 5 minutes, until steaming hot in the middle.
Fill the buns with the frankfurts, chilli and mustard.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C and the frankfurts must be steaming hot. Refrigerate leftover chilli within an hour; it keeps 3 days and freezes well.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Rye Sandwiches
recipes.summary: Dark rye with whipped cream cheese, smoked salmon, cucumber and capers, a quick no-cook lunch.
steps: Mix the cream cheese with the dill and a squeeze of lemon.
Spread over the rye until the bread is fully covered.
Lay the salmon, cucumber and capers over two slices, season with pepper and top with the other slices.
notes: Food safety: smoked salmon is ready to eat but should be avoided by anyone pregnant or immunocompromised. Keep below 5°C; for a packed lunch use an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
Contains fish, milk and gluten.

recipes.title: Prawn and Corn Quesadillas (with Lime)
recipes.summary: Juicy prawns, sweet corn and capsicum under melted cheese in a crisp tortilla, finished with lime and coriander.
steps: Cook the prawns, corn, capsicum and cumin in half the oil for 4 minutes, until the prawns are pink and opaque.
Spread over half of each tortilla, add the cheese and coriander and fold over.
Cook in the remaining oil for 3 minutes each side, until golden and the cheese has melted. Serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: prawns must be pink and opaque right through. Eat hot; for a packed lunch use an ice pack, eat within 4 hours and reheat until steaming.
Contains crustacean, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Tacos de Chorizo y Papa (Chorizo and Potato Tacos)
recipes.summary: Crumbled chorizo fried with golden potato and spooned into warm corn tortillas with salsa and coriander.
steps: Boil the potato for 8 minutes until almost tender and drain.
Fry the chorizo in a dry pan for 5 minutes until the fat runs and it is crisp, then add the onion and potato and cook for 8 minutes, until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the mixture, salsa and coriander.
notes: Food safety: chorizo should be cooked until sizzling and hot all the way through. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Check the chorizo label for gluten.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower Tacos (with Lime Yoghurt)
recipes.summary: Spiced roasted cauliflower in corn tortillas with avocado, red cabbage and a cooling lime yoghurt.
steps: Toss the cauliflower with the oil, paprika, cumin and salt and roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 25 minutes, turning once, until charred and tender.
Stir the lime juice into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas and fill with cauliflower, avocado and cabbage, then drizzle with the yoghurt.
notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge; assemble just before eating.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Tacos (with Onion and Coriander)
recipes.summary: Lime and garlic skirt steak seared fast and chopped into warm corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa.
steps: Rub the steak with the lime juice, garlic, cumin, oil and 1 tsp salt.
Sear in a very hot pan for 3 minutes each side for medium, until charred with a centre of 60°C. Rest for 5 minutes, then chop finely.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the steak, onion, coriander and salsa.
notes: Food safety: whole steak is safe medium once seared on the outside; cook through for anyone vulnerable. For a packed lunch keep with an ice pack and eat within 4 hours.
No dairy or gluten in the ingredients.

recipes.title: Sweetcorn Fritters (with Avocado and Lime)
recipes.summary: Golden corn and spring onion fritters topped with smashed avocado, a brunch-cafe lunch ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, eggs, milk and a pinch of salt into a thick batter. Stir through the corn and spring onion.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil in batches for 2 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through in the middle.
Smash the avocado with the lime juice and salt and spoon over the fritters.
notes: Food safety: fritters must be cooked through with no raw batter. Keep 2 days in the fridge and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains egg, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Hoisin Chicken Bao Buns (with Cucumber)
recipes.summary: Steamed bao filled with sticky hoisin chicken, cucumber, spring onion and a little coriander.
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes, until cooked through to 75°C. Add the hoisin and soy sauce and toss for 1 minute, until sticky.
Steam the buns for 8 minutes, until soft and puffed.
Open the buns and fill with the chicken, cucumber, spring onion and coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Refrigerate leftover chicken within an hour and reheat until steaming hot; steam leftover buns until hot all the way through.
Contains gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Paper Rolls (with Peanut Dipping Sauce)
recipes.summary: Fresh rolls of shredded chicken, vermicelli and herbs in rice paper with a creamy peanut hoisin dip.
steps: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until soft, then drain and rinse.
Dip a rice paper in warm water for 10 seconds, lay it flat and layer lettuce, noodles, chicken, carrot, cucumber and herbs on the lower third.
Fold in the sides and roll up firmly until the roll is tight. Repeat for 12 rolls.
Whisk the peanut butter, hoisin, lime juice and 3 tbsp warm water until smooth, for dipping.
notes: Food safety: use chicken that was cooked through to 75°C and chilled within an hour. Fresh rolls are best eaten within 4 hours; for a packed lunch keep with an ice pack and cover with a damp cloth.
Contains peanuts and soy; check the hoisin label for gluten.
